title: Prevent OneDrive file sync via policy (DisableFileSyncNGSC)
description: Sets the documented policy value DisableFileSyncNGSC under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OneDrive to 1, preventing the use of OneDrive for file storage and sync on this device. Files already synced remain available locally; removing the policy restores sync. The previous value and its type are captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo.
